title: 第8章 追思前缘
content_zh:
方玲伏在父亲尸上，眼见这场惊心动魄的恶战，吓得呆了，最后见秦英豪倒下，忙走上相扶，但秦英豪身躯高大，她娇弱无力，又怎扶得起来？秦英豪神智尚清，下半身却已麻木，指着李西川说：“搜他身边，取解药给我服。”方玲依言搜索，果然找到一个小小瓷瓶，问秦英豪：“是这个么？”秦英豪昏昏沉沉，已自难辨，说道：“不管是不是，服……服了再说。”

    方玲拔开瓶塞，将小半瓶黄色药粉倒在左掌，送入秦英豪口里。秦英豪用力吞下，说道：“快将他杀了！”方玲大吃一惊，说道：“我……我不敢……杀人。”秦英豪厉声说：“他是你杀父仇人！”方玲仍然说：“我……我不敢……”秦英豪说：“再过几个小时，他穴道自解。我受伤很重……那时咱两人死无葬身之地……”

    方玲双手提起宝刀，拔出刀鞘，眼见李西川眼中露出哀求之色，她自小杀鸡杀鱼也不敢，这杀人的一刀如何砍得下去？

    秦英豪大喝：“你不杀他，便是杀我！”他声如巨雷，把方玲吓了一跳，身子一颤，宝刀脱手掉下。这刀砍金断玉，刃口正好对准李西川的脑袋。只听方玲与李西川同声大叫，一个昏晕，软软摔下，跌在秦英豪身上，另一个的脑袋已让宝刀劈开。

    秦英豪想到此处，怀中女儿已经醒来，哭着问：“爸爸，找到妈妈了吗？”秦英豪还没回答，那女孩一转头，陡然见到火堆旁的美妇，张开双臂，大叫：“是妈妈！是妈妈！佳茵要妈妈抱！”欢然喜跃，要那美妇来抱。

    四周众人听那女孩先叫秦英豪“爸爸”，又叫那美妇“妈妈”，都大感惊异，心想这美妇明明是李丰粮之妻，怎么又会是秦英豪女儿的妈妈？那女孩这两声妈妈一叫，大厅中紧张的气氛又自浓了几分。几十个大人个个神色沉重，那女孩却欢跃不已。

    美妇站起身来，走到秦英豪身旁抱过孩子。女孩笑着说：“妈妈，佳茵和爸爸在找你，你抱佳茵回家。”美妇紧紧搂着她，两张美丽的脸庞偎倚在一起。女孩在梦中流的泪水还没干，这时脸颊上又添了母亲的眼泪。

    脸有刀疤的乞丐一直缩身厅角，静观各人，这时轻轻站起，走到盗魁曹虎身前，在他耳边悄悄说了几句话。曹虎神色大变，忽地站起，向秦英豪望了一眼，脸上大有惧色，缓缓伸手入怀，取出一个油纸小包。乞丐夹手夺过，打开一看，见里面是两张焦黄的纸片。他点了点头，包好了放入怀内，重新回到厅角坐下。

    美妇伸衣袖抹了抹眼泪，突然在女孩脸上深深一吻，眼圈一红，又要流出泪来，终于强行忍住，霍地站起，把女孩交还给了秦英豪。女孩大叫：“妈妈！妈妈！抱抱佳茵！抱抱佳茵！”美妇背向着她，宛似僵住了一般，始终不转过身来。

    秦英豪耐着性子等待，等那美妇答应一声，等她回过头来再瞧女儿一眼……

The two stood side by side in the darkness, silent for a long time, when they suddenly heard a click on the roof tiles.Min Jiageng was overjoyed and said that Yi Diandian left and came back. He couldn't help shouting: "You...you are back!" Suddenly he heard a man's voice in the room saying: "Brother Min, please take a step to speak." The voice belonged to Shi Yan, who loved swords as much as his life.

Min Jiageng said: "There is no one else here except my sworn sister. Brother Shi, please come in and have a drink."

That day, Min Jiageng didn't destroy his sword, and Shi Yan was always grateful. When Yi Diandian was fighting with Bao Jinpeng, Li Hongsheng, and Gong Guozhao, he saw that Min Jiageng was partial to Yi Diandian, so he kept silent. When he heard what Min Jiageng said, he immediately jumped down and said, "An old friend of yours ordered me to come, please drive over for a while."

Min Jiageng asked curiously: "My old friend? Who is it?" Shi Yan said: "I was ordered not to leak it. Please forgive me. Brothers know each other when they meet. This friend is very grateful to you and has no ill intentions." Min Jiageng looked at Yu Sheng.Yan said: "You stay here for a moment, I will be back before dawn." Yu Sheng turned around and took his single sword and asked: "Do you bring a weapon?" Min Jiageng saw that Shi Yan did not have a sword tied to his waist and said: "Since I am an old friend, I invite you, so there is no need to bring it."

The two of them went out from the gate, and there was a luxury car parked outside the door. The car was surrounded by gold paint and gauze, which was very luxurious.Min Jiageng thought: "Is this Zhu Jinya trying another trick? If I bump into him again this time, even with my bare hands, I will kill him with one palm."

The two got into the car and sat down, and the driver sped away.When Wei went to Beijing, driving and riding were not allowed during the night, but when the night watch police officer saw the license plate, he stepped aside and saluted on the street, and then let the car pass.

After driving for about an hour, the driver stopped in front of a large wall of prohibited items.Shi Yan jumped out of the car first and led Min Jiageng into a small door, along a row of cobblestone flower paths, and into a garden.This garden is so big, with luxuriant flowers and trees, seemingly endless pavilions, corridors, rockeries, and ponds, and gauze lanterns are lit everywhere in the pavilions.

Min Jiageng secretly marveled: "Zhu Jinya is really powerful. If you don't have billions to buy this garden, I'm afraid you need to be powerful to do it. He has accumulated a lot of illegal money in Longxi." But then he thought again: "I'm afraid he may not be the evil thief named Zhu. No matter how strong he is, he is just a local tyrant in Guangdong, how can he be inferior to a police officer like Shi Yan?"

While he was thinking about it, Shi Yan led him around a stone barrier made of rockery, crossed a wooden bridge, and walked into a water pavilion.Two red candles were lit in the pavilion, and teacups and teacups were placed on the table.Shi Yan said, "My dear friend, I'll be here soon. I'm waiting outside the door." After that, he turned around and went out.

Min Jiageng looked at the furnishings in this pavilion and saw that it was exquisite, elegant and full of wealth. The villa outside the Weiyuan Gate was also very gorgeous, but compared with this small pavilion, it was far inferior.A banner was hung on the wall at the west end, with a piece of "Xia Ke Xing" written by a modern person written in regular script. Min Jiageng read silently:

Seeking power and fighting for temple positions, forming cliques to cover up dirty deeds.At the Cross Money and Food Festival, the sound of chickens and dogs was heard in the middle of the hall.

The dirty yarn hides the greasy smell, and the tiger covers the flies.Huaibi's fist dominates, and the wild beasts in Tang Street dominate.

Yin and yang makeup box, black and white bundle of love.The country held fusang sacrifices and built Ye City in the cold weather.

The shrine houses the ghost bandits, and the merchant girl spits in the pit.Addicted to Western kisses and obsessed with Edo soup.
